fields.Name: Sales: Party Lookup Contacts
fields.UserQuestion: Which sales contacts start with what I have typed?
fields.Description: Search for the Deal form's contact pickers: sales contacts whose last name, display name, email or email domain starts with the term.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Grain: Person with a SalesContact row (the IsA subtype the Deal's contact FKs reference; subtype ID = Person ID). Party lookup contract (bc-aidp-next-golive#372): columns ID, Name (DisplayName), Detail (Email); parameters Term (required) and Domain (optional; matched against Person.EmailDomain). Prefix LIKE on indexed base columns, TOP 20 ordered by DisplayName, no view and no count. Called by bizapps-party-field from @mj-biz-apps/common-ng.
